name: my-webserver
description: my-webserver — local file server with Markdown, JSON/YAML table, and Eruda DevTools rendering. Ships as a prebuilt, per-arch Node Single Executable Application binary.

build._remote_note: The Node Single Executable Application build (node --experimental-sea-config + postject injection, both architectures) is heavy and fragile across environments — built on GHA (ship-my-webserver-app.yml), published to the rolling GitHub Release, and fetched by the desktop and Termux nix modules. Never built locally.
